<P STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">This Amendment No. 12 (&#8220;<U>Amendment No. 12</U>&#8221;) amends
and supplements the statement on Schedule 13D (the &#8220;<U>Original Schedule 13D</U>&#8221;) filed with the Securities and Exchange
Commission (the &#8220;<U>SEC</U>&#8221;) on July 21, 2014, as amended by Amendment No. 1 (&#8220;<U>Amendment No. 1</U>&#8221;)
filed with the SEC on July 23, 2015, Amendment No. 2 (&#8220;<U>Amendment No. 2</U>&#8221;) filed with the SEC on September 17,
2015, Amendment No. 3 (&#8220;<U>Amendment No. 3</U>&#8221;) filed with the SEC on May 11, 2016, Amendment No. 4 (&#8220;<U>Amendment
No. 4</U>&#8221;) filed with the SEC on June 10, 2016, Amendment No. 5 (&#8220;<U>Amendment No. 5</U>&#8221;) filed with the SEC
on July 1, 2016, Amendment No. 6 (&#8220;<U>Amendment No. 6&#8221;)</U> filed with the SEC on October 11, 2016, Amendment No. 7
(&#8220;<U>Amendment No. 7&#8221;)</U> filed with the SEC on October 31, 2016, Amendment No. 8 (&#8220;<U>Amendment No. 8&#8221;)</U>
filed with the SEC on December 6, 2016, Amendment No. 9 (&#8220;<U>Amendment No. 9&#8221;)</U> filed with the SEC on January 6,
2017, Amendment No. 10 (&#8220;<U>Amendment No. 10&#8221;)</U> filed with the SEC on December 13, 2017 and Amendment No. 11 (&#8220;<U>Amendment
No. 11&#8221;)</U> filed with the SEC on February 6, 2018 (the Original Schedule 13D as amended by Amendment No. 1, Amendment No.
2, Amendment No. 3, Amendment No. 4, Amendment No. 5, Amendment No. 6, Amendment No. 7, Amendment No. 8, Amendment No. 9, Amendment
No. 10, Amendment No. 11 and this Amendment No. 12, the &#8220;<U>Schedule 13D</U>&#8221;), with respect to the shares of common
stock, par value $0.01 per share (the &#8220;<U>Common Stock</U>&#8221;) of Genco Shipping &amp; Trading Limited, a corporation
organized under the laws of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (the &#8220;<U>Issuer</U>&#8221;). This Amendment No. 12 amends
Item 2, 5 and 6 as set forth below.</P>

        <P STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">On December 18, 2020, CCP, CCPM, CSCP Cayman and CSCP II entered
        into a Rule 10b5-1 Sales Plan (the &quot;<U>10b5-1 Plan</U>&quot;) with Jeffries LLC (&quot;<U>Jefferies</U>&quot;). Pursuant to
        the 10b5-1 Plan, Jefferies may sell up to an aggregate of 5,639,100 shares of Common Stock owned by such entities, subject to the
        satisfaction of certain conditions, including, among others, minimum trading prices. The 10b5-1 Plan will terminate on the earlier
        of the date on which all of the shares to be sold under the 10b5-1 Plan are sold or the date the 10b5-1 Plan is otherwise terminated.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B><U>SCHEDULE A</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase">Transactions
in the SHARES OF COMMON STOCK of the Issuer<BR>
